rationale: Although price has slipped slightly below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.11) to $15.04, the pullback is occurring on relatively light 1-minute volume within a dominant uptrend (88.1% of the daily range on 6.15x relative volume) and a strongly positive broad market (SPY +2.25%). Because the original thesis specifically placed invalidation at the $15.00 round-number support to allow for roughly 1.2x 5m ATR of noise, holding to let that key level be tested or defended remains the highest-expectancy play.
